params.1273: Cut a log from a regular tree.
params.1274: Get a hatchet (you can get one free from Bob's Brilliant Axes in Lumbridge).
params.1275: Find any regular or dead tree.
params.1276: Click on the tree while you have your hatchet to start cutting it.
params.1277: You don't need to equip the hatchet, but this can save some inventory room.
params.2225: Successfully cutting a log from a tree earns you 25 Woodcutting experience. Logs can be used in Firemaking or Fletching.
